    Text · top

    Inline formatting, roles, and emoji

    #
    Use _emphasis_, *strong text*, and *_strong emphasis_* with `inline code`.

Roles include @mark[marked], @delete[removed], @sub[2], @sup[n], and @key[Command K].

Ship :rocket: with :sparkles:. Unknown :not_an_emoji: and escaped \:rocket: remain text. Code `:rocket:` remains literal.
    Use *emphasis*, **strong text**, and ***strong emphasis*** with `inline code`.

Roles include <mark>marked</mark>, ~~removed~~, H<sub>2</sub>O, x<sup>n</sup>, and <kbd>Command K</kbd>.

Ship 🚀 with ✨. Unknown :not_an_emoji: and escaped :rocket: remain text. Code `:rocket:` remains literal.

    Expected HTML

    Use emphasis, strong text, and strong emphasis with inline code.

    Roles include marked, removed, H2O, xn, and Command K.

    Ship 🚀 with ✨. Unknown :not_an_emoji: and escaped :rocket: remain text. Code :rocket: remains literal.

    Imports · top

    Imports, includes, formats, and modes

    #
    # Import forms

@include src="shared/introduction.mpd" mode="fragment"

@import src="README.md" format="markdown" profile="gfm" mode="document"

@import src="api/openapi.yaml" format="openapi" mode="data" as="api"
    # Import forms

Imports are resolved before Markdown export. This portable reference records the three supported forms without executing them.

- Include an MPD fragment from `shared/introduction.mpd`.
- Import a complete GFM document from `README.md`.
- Load `api/openapi.yaml` as structured OpenAPI data named `api`.

    Expected HTML

    Imports are resolved before Markdown export. This portable reference records the three supported forms without executing them.

    • Include an MPD fragment from shared/introduction.mpd.
    • Import a complete GFM document from README.md.
    • Load api/openapi.yaml as structured OpenAPI data named api.
